question: Can the fixed architecture and budget fit one known hardest training trajectory?
comparison: Identical architecture, initialization, label batches, IC samples, Adam, and step budget; physics adds PDE and periodic BC penalties.
limitations: One known training control is not an operator-generalization test.
Remaining points assess interpolation of the same trajectory, not unseen control functions.
One seed and one budget cannot separate representation limits from optimization limits.
The comparison changes PDE and BC penalties together; it does not isolate either term individually.
No test controls were used to choose this diagnostic or fit either model.

training_summary.architecture: complex branch/trunk DeepONet with Fourier coordinate features
notes: Pilot DeepONet; not the published FNO/PINO architecture.
Physics residual uses raw complex states, g as configured, and interpolated complete controls.
Supervised mode keeps the same data and initial-state labels while omitting physics penalties.
Raw losses are logged separately; the PDE term in total loss is divided by residual_scale squared.
Validation controls are not used for training or checkpoint selection; reserve a separate test split.
